notes: 'To what purpose' is split with 'purpose' as the supplied completion of מָה; the alternative gives 'purpose' to זֶה, but the demonstrative has no such lexeme.
לָמָּה is split because the ASV spends a word on each morpheme, unlike לָכֵן → 'Therefore', which fuses under rule 30's one-English-rendering condition.
The לְ of לְרָצוֹן carries the clause's supplied 'are' as a prepositional predicate (rule 49).
